intro: Offices, teams, deadlines and meetings: the vocabulary of working on a project in Spain.

el cliente.nota: Feminine: la clienta; el cliente can also be used for both.

entregar.nota: G becomes gu before e: entregué.

retrasarse.en: to fall behind; to be late

cumplir con.en: to meet (a deadline); to comply with

bloques.titulo: Working life from contract to deadline
bloques.texto:
**Two ways of working.** **Por cuenta ajena**: you are an employee. **Por cuenta propia**: you are **autónomo**.

**The office.** **El equipo**, **la jefa**, **el compañero**, **el cliente**. **La reunión**, **el informe**, **el presupuesto**, **el plazo**, **la entrega**.

**The contract and hours.** **Indefinido** or **fijo** (permanent), **temporal**, **de prácticas**. It begins with **un periodo de prueba**. You work **a tiempo completo** or **a tiempo parcial**, with **jornada continua** or **jornada partida** (with a long lunch break). Many offices offer **horario flexible** and **teletrabajo**.

**Pay.** **El sueldo** or **el salario**, written on **la nómina**. In Spain most workers get two **pagas extra**, in summer and at Christmas. Also **horas extra**, **dietas** (expenses) and **comisiones**.

**Moving up.** **Ascender** and **el ascenso**; **pedir un aumento**; **renovar** el contrato.

**Absence.** **Estar de baja** (ill), **pedir un día libre**, **un día de permiso**.

**Deadlines.** **Cumplir con el plazo**, **entregar** el informe a tiempo, **retrasarse**, **ir con retraso**.

**The staff.** **La plantilla** is all the workers in a company.

frases.es: El equipo de la oficina, formado por unos treinta trabajadores, lleva dos semanas con el nuevo proyecto.
frases.en: The office team, made up of some thirty workers, has been on the new project for two weeks.

frases.es: El retraso empezó cuando el cliente anunció que no aceptaría el primer presupuesto.
frases.en: The delay began when the client announced that he would not accept the first budget.

frases.es: Según los jefes de sección, la mitad de los empleados encadena reuniones de tres horas desde hace semanas.
frases.en: According to the section heads, half the employees have been going from one three-hour meeting to the next for weeks.

frases.es: Piden que se les dé más ayuda y que se respete el horario, que fija una jornada de ocho horas.
frases.en: They ask to be given more help and for the schedule, which sets an eight-hour day, to be respected.
analisis: que fija una jornada de ocho horas

frases.es: La jefa del proyecto responde que, de aceptar esas condiciones, tendría que contratar a cinco personas.
frases.en: The project manager replies that, if she accepted those conditions, she would have to hire five people.

frases.es: Ayer ofreció un día libre extra a quienes se queden hasta tarde, pero la oferta fue rechazada.
frases.en: Yesterday she offered an extra day off to those who stay late, but the offer was turned down.
analisis: a quienes se queden hasta tarde

frases.es: Mientras no haya un plan claro, advierten los compañeros, no se terminará ni un solo informe.
frases.en: As long as there is no clear plan, the colleagues warn, not a single report will be finished.
analisis: Mientras no haya un plan claro

bloques.pregunta: According to the text, what started the delay?

opciones.The client would not accept the first bu: Anunció que no aceptaría el primer presupuesto.
opciones.The office closed for the holidays: Not mentioned; the delay began with the budget.
opciones.Five people left the team: Hiring five people is only what the manager says would be needed.

bloques.correcta: The client would not accept the first budget

bloques.pregunta: According to the text, what happened to the company's offer?

opciones.We are running late: Ir con retraso: to be behind schedule.
opciones.We are going backwards: Retraso is delay, not a direction.
opciones.We are very pleased: It is a work term about time.

bloques.pregunta: Complete: as long as there is no plan…
bloques.frase: Mientras no ___ un plan claro, seguirá el retraso.

opciones.haya: Mientras as a condition about the future takes the subjunctive.
opciones.hay: With the indicative, mientras means while. Here it means as long as.

bloques.pregunta: The person who buys your work or service is…

opciones.el cliente: El cliente is the person who buys your work or service.
opciones.el jefe: That is the person who directs the team.
opciones.el compañero: That is someone who works with you.

bloques.frase: La han ascendido a jefa de sección.

opciones.texto: She has been promoted to head of section.
opciones.explicacion: La han ascendido means she has been promoted to a higher post.

opciones.texto: She has gone up to see the head of section.
opciones.explicacion: Ascender a alguien: to promote someone.

opciones.texto: She has been dismissed as head of section.

bloques.frase: Todo el equipo trabaja en el proyecto desde el lunes
bloques.traduccion: The whole team has been working on the project since Monday.

bloques.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write a newspaper-style report on a project with a tight deadline, giving the position of the team and of the client.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Talk aloud about working conditions in your sector and what you would change.
